deviations.source_decision: Rubric 3 names the class tier headline YOU WERE THERE.
deviations.implementation_decision: A mark made while the class is in session (I'M HERE) says YOU'RE HERE.; every ended class says YOU WERE THERE.
deviations.reason: The button says I'M HERE while he is in the room; a past-tense answer to it would read wrong.
deviations.user_visible_consequence: Only an in-session mark shows the present-tense headline.

deviations.source_decision: Concept B shows a week strip with empty diamonds on the glass.
deviations.implementation_decision: No week strip on the card.
deviations.reason: Never punish: no hollow sockets or counts of unmarked classes.
deviations.user_visible_consequence: The card is shorter; the week shows only in the week tier's count.

deviations.source_decision: Concept B and the first build named the day's total beside the kept count (TUESDAY · 2 CLASSES, 1 ATTENDED).
deviations.implementation_decision: Once anything is kept the header is the day name and N ATTENDED; the total shows only before the first keep.
deviations.reason: Rubric: no N of M, no counts of unmarked classes.
deviations.user_visible_consequence: After a mark the header reads TUESDAY with 1 ATTENDED.

deviations.source_decision: Rubric 6: once the wind-down begins the room owns the frame and the day's record folds to one line.
deviations.implementation_decision: While a class can still be marked (until its night ends at 4 AM) the evening glass keeps the card with I WAS THERE and the shortcut, with Write a line and Close the day under it; the music row joins once nothing waits and the day is one line.
deviations.reason: His Monday and Thursday wind-downs begin the minute his last class ends: folding the day then would hide the one-press mark exactly when he opens the app after class.
deviations.user_visible_consequence: At Mon 19:15 with nothing marked the room is a band above a tall glass; after the mark it opens up.

deviations.source_decision: Concept B's evening record carried tomorrow's first class and a week strip.
deviations.implementation_decision: The evening glass has the one line, the music and the doors only.
deviations.reason: Rubric 6 folds the record to one line; the closing line of the day's celebration and the night ledger already name what is next.
deviations.user_visible_consequence: No tomorrow line in the evening glass.

deviations.source_decision: Concept B put the music on a brass plate fixed to the lamp.
deviations.implementation_decision: The music is a row in the glass (MUSIC, Lamp left on, a fine brass ring with play or pause).
